svg.title: ARMOR-NODE-RADAR architecture
svg.desc: The firmware of ARMOR-NODE-RADAR reads up to three radars, keeps a track's identity, publishes the messages the ARMOR-COMMON contract accepts, serves a web panel with its own HTTPS certificate and installs only signed updates. It is the one node that exists as hardware; the perimeter engine, the LD2461 and presence-sensor decoders and the TLS link to the broker have not run with real modules or on a board.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: A radar node of up to 270 degrees: three LD2450 on three UARTs, a web panel, signed updates and a link to the broker, on one firmware for every board.
